frame.note: x=0 is the team's own alliance wall, +x toward the opponent wall; y follows WPILib after the symmetry transform; *_norm values are 0..1 of the full field

legend: Teleop time with smoothed alliance-perspective x >= 11.51 m: inside the opponent's alliance zone or within 1 m of it. Ranked on the share of tracked teleop time (pooled over counted matches); s/match is raw, 'per 140 s' = share × 140 s (what a fully tracked match would show). Long = matches with >= 15 s there. Being there is not proof of defense (a robot can also feed or get pushed). Positions are median-smoothed over 1 s; speed = smoothed displacement across a centred 1 s window ÷ its duration, never across a tracking gap > 0.6 s or a tracker-slot change. Runs of bit-identical positions longer than 0.5 s are stalled tracking: if the robot is still within 0.3 m of that spot when tracking resumes it sat still (counted as stationary), otherwise those seconds are unknown and excluded. A match counts only with >= 30 s of valid tracking; fewer than 2 counted matches = low data.
